summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packets on node1. Verified all interfaces remain hardened after a full node restart. Ubuntu 16.04 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic were retained.
actions_performed: Created /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf with global, default, ens2, and loopback protections.
Applied and verified the settings on every current IPv4 interface.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed recovery with a changed boot identity.
Verified the persistent configuration, runtime values, system state, address, and default route after restart.

evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packets
evidence.summary: Before and after restart, accept_redirects and accept_source_route were zero for all, default, ens2, and lo; the persistent sysctl file was present.

evidence.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel

evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline boot ID fa1e87e6-00f3-42d2-acc5-ad1df6c3d16a, restart acknowledgement and temporary SSH unavailability, then changed boot ID a5aa6a64-d512-4959-8044-b549a468f613 and recovered system/network/hardening state.
